exports.name: resolveConfig

comment.summary:
Resolve a configuration to actual plugin and extractor instances.

Plugin resolution follows this priority:
1. If `config.plugins` contains Plugin instances (from TS configs), use directly
2. If `config.plugins` contains string/tuple references (from JSON configs),
   resolve them by dynamically importing the package and calling its factory
3. If no plugins specified at all, auto-detect installed plugin packages

exports.name: runParsePipeline

comment.summary:
Run file content through a parser pipeline.
Parsers execute in order, each receiving the output of the previous.

Hunks are accumulated across parsers automatically. Each parser receives
an empty hunks array and only needs to return its own hunks. The pipeline
merges them in order so parsers don't need to preserve earlier hunks.

an empty hunks array and only needs to return its own hunks. The pipeline

Scan a directory for examples using the provided extractors.

1. Runs all extractors in parallel against the root

4. Applies include/exclude filters AFTER extraction
5. Returns unified results

exports.name: resolveConfig

comment.summary:
Resolve a configuration to actual plugin and extractor instances.

Plugin resolution follows this priority:
1. If `config.plugins` contains Plugin instances (from TS configs), use directly
2. If `config.plugins` contains string/tuple references (from JSON configs),
   resolve them by dynamically importing the package and calling its factory
3. If no plugins specified at all, auto-detect installed plugin packages

exports.name: runParsePipeline

comment.summary:
Run file content through a parser pipeline.
Parsers execute in order, each receiving the output of the previous.

Hunks are accumulated across parsers automatically. Each parser receives
an empty hunks array and only needs to return its own hunks. The pipeline
merges them in order so parsers don't need to preserve earlier hunks.

comment.summary:

This is the simplest entry point for programmatic scanning.
It discovers the nearest config file, loads it, resolves plugins,
and runs the scanner — all in one call.

exports.name: scanExamples

comment.summary:
Scan a directory for examples using the provided extractors.

The scanner:
1. Runs all extractors in parallel against the root
2. Collects claimed files and detects conflicts
3. Resolves conflicts via path mappings (or errors if unresolved)
4. Applies include/exclude filters AFTER extraction
5. Returns unified results
